faqs.q: What is Enerpac HF and LX hydraulic oil?
faqs.a: Enerpac HF and LX hydraulic oil is Enerpac-branded hydraulic oil sold in cans and drums for hydraulic pumps and tools. The listing has 5 part numbers, including the LX101 oil for hand pumps.

faqs.q: What do the Enerpac oil part numbers HF100, HF101, HF102, HF104 and LX101 mean?
faqs.a: HF100 is the 1-quart can, HF101 the 1-gallon can, HF102 the 5-gallon pail and HF104 the 55-gallon drum of Enerpac HF hydraulic oil, and LX101 is 1 gallon of Enerpac hydraulic oil for hand pumps.

faqs.q: What container sizes does Enerpac HF hydraulic oil come in?
faqs.a: HF oil comes in 1-quart (HF100), 1-gallon (HF101), 5-gallon (HF102) and 55-gallon drum (HF104) sizes. Choose the pack by how many pumps you top up and how often.

faqs.q: Which Enerpac oil is for hand pumps?
faqs.a: Enerpac LX101 is listed as 1-gallon Enerpac hydraulic oil for hand pumps. Always use the oil grade the pump maker specifies for your own pump, and check the pump manual first.

faqs.q: How do I choose between Enerpac HF and LX oil?
faqs.a: Use the oil grade the pump maker specifies. The listing names HF oil in four pack sizes and LX101 as the hand pump oil, so check your pump’s manual or its filler cap marking.

faqs.q: Which equipment uses Enerpac hydraulic oil?
faqs.a: It is used to fill and top up Enerpac hand pumps and hydraulic tools, so check your pump’s manual for the oil it takes. See our [hydraulic jacks, wedges and skates guide](/blog/hydraulic-jacks-wedges-and-skates) for the equipment these oils top up.

faqs.q: When should hydraulic oil in an Enerpac pump be topped up?
faqs.a: Top up to the level the pump maker specifies using the oil grade it states, and keep the filler area clean. Do not mix oil grades unless the pump maker allows it.

faqs.q: Where is Enerpac hydraulic oil used?
faqs.a: It is used to fill and top up Enerpac hand pumps and hydraulic tools on maintenance and workshop jobs. Drums suit workshops and cans suit toolboxes.

faqs.q: Is a 5-gallon pail or a 55-gallon drum of Enerpac HF oil better?
faqs.a: A 55-gallon drum (HF104) suits workshops that refill many pumps, while the 5-gallon pail (HF102) and 1-gallon can (HF101) suit field kits. All are Enerpac HF oil.
